strings.serverParam.a2sAddress.tooltip:
IP address to which A2S socket will be bound.
It can be used to restrict A2S queries to a particular network interface.
strings.serverParam.a2sPort.tooltip: Change Steam Query UDP port on which game listens to A2S requests.
strings.serverParam.address.label: A2S Address
strings.serverParam.adminPassword.tooltip:
Defines the server's admin password, allows a server administrator to login and control the server.
To access this either open the chat input box by pressing C in the lobby or Enter in-game followed by: #login [the admin password]
strings.serverParam.admins.label: Admins
strings.serverParam.admins.tooltip: List of admins by their identityIds and/or steamIds. These users can use admin commands without using the Admin Password.
strings.serverParam.aiLimit.label: AI Limit
strings.serverParam.aiLimit.tooltip:
Sets the top limit of AIs. No system will be able to spawn any AIs when this ceiling is reached.
A negative number is not considered as valid value and is then ignored - limit is not applied.
strings.serverParam.autoSaveInterval.label: Auto Save Interval (mins)
strings.serverParam.autoSaveInterval.tooltip:
Interval (in minutes) at which automatic saves are created, if possible for the current mission. Disabled if set to 0.
Requires Persistence System enabled.
strings.serverParam.battlEye.label: BattlEye
strings.serverParam.bindAddress.label: Bind Address
strings.serverParam.bindAddress.tooltip:
IP address to which the server socket will be bound. In most cases, this should be left empty.
It can be used to restrict connections to a particular network interface. When left out or empty, 0.0.0.0 is used, which allows connections through any IP address.
strings.serverParam.bindPort.label: Bind Port
strings.serverParam.bindPort.tooltip: UDP port to which the server socket will be bound.
strings.serverParam.crossPlatform.label: Cross Platform
strings.serverParam.crossPlatform.tooltip: If enabled, Xbox and PlayStation clients will be able to connect to the server.
strings.serverParam.databases.label: Databases
strings.serverParam.databases.tooltip:
Case-insensitive named objects representing an override of the system configuration provided databases or the addition of a new one.
Optional child properties:
	"preset" - refers to database config presets that are defined in game/mod data. Full resource name.
	"options" - a complex object which corresponds to the individual database type of the preset. Usually, a key-value collection
Requires Persistence System enabled.
strings.serverParam.disableAI.label: Disable AI
strings.serverParam.disableAi.tooltip:
If enabled, the server will prevent initialization and ticking of AIWorld and its components.
Will completely disable AI functionality on the server.
strings.serverParam.disableCrashReport.tooltip: If enabled, the automatic server-side Crash Report is disabled.
strings.serverParam.disableCrashReporter.label: Disable Crash Reporter
strings.serverParam.disableNavmeshStreaming.tool:
If enabled, the server will disable navmesh streaming on all navmesh components and load the entire navmesh into memory.
This setting provides slightly better server performance and reaction times of moving AIs at the cost of higher memory consumption (up to hundreds of MB depending on the terrain).
strings.serverParam.disableServerShutdown.label: Disable Server Shutdown
strings.serverParam.disableServerShutdown.toolti:
If enabled, the server will not automatically shutdown if connection to backend is lost.
Related to room requests errors - other causes like corrupted config will still shutdown the server.
strings.serverParam.disableSpecificNavmeshStream:
Used in conjunction with 'Disable Navmesh Streaming'.
If any navmeshes are specified here, it will disable streaming of listed navmeshes, while streaming all remaining navmeshes.
strings.serverParam.disableThirdPerson.label: Disable Third Person
strings.serverParam.disableThirdPerson.tooltip: Force clients to use the first-person view.
strings.serverParam.enablePersistence.tooltip: Enable the Persistence System on your server. Note that in most cases, the defaults work well enough and this doesn't need to be enabled.
strings.serverParam.enableRcon.tooltip: Enable RCON on your server. You must also specify a password for it successfully start.
strings.serverParam.fastValidation.label: Fast Validation
strings.serverParam.fastValidation.tooltip:
Validation of map entities and components loaded on client when it joins, ensuring things match with initial server state.

Enabled - minimum information required to make sure data matches is exchanged between client.
	When a mismatch occurs, no additional information will be available for determining where client and server states start to differ.
	All servers that expect clients to connect over internet should have fast validation enabled.

Disabled - extra data for every replicated entity and component in the map will be transferred when new client connects to the server.
	When a mismatch occurs, it is possible to point at particular entity or component where things start to differ.
	When developing locally (ie. both server and client run on the same machine), it is fine to disable fast validation to more easily pin point source of the problem.
strings.serverParam.hiveId.label: Hive ID
strings.serverParam.hiveId.tooltip:
Number identifying each hive (server) when they share the same persistence database. Used for separating UUIDs for save game data.
Requires Persistence System enabled.
strings.serverParam.joinQueueMaxSize.tooltip: Sets the maximum number of players that can queue to join the server.
strings.serverParam.keepSessionSave.label: Keep Session Save
strings.serverParam.keepSessionSave.tooltip:
Keep the playthrough save points after the mission is finished.
Requires Persistence System enabled.
strings.serverParam.loadSessionSave.label: Load Session Save
strings.serverParam.loadSessionSave.tooltip:
Automatically load the latest available save point on first startup.
Requires Persistence System enabled.
strings.serverParam.lobbyPlayerSync.tooltip: If enabled, the list of player identities present on server is sent to the GameAPI along with the server's heartbeat.
strings.serverParam.lobbyPlayerSynchronise.label: Lobby Player Synchronise
strings.serverParam.maxPlayers.label: Max Players
strings.serverParam.maxPlayers.tooltip: Set the maximum amount of players on the server.
strings.serverParam.maxSize.label: Join Queue Max Size
strings.serverParam.maxViewDistance.tooltip: Maximum view distance enforced by the server.
strings.serverParam.minGrassDistance.tooltip: Minimum grass distance in meters. Lowest allowed value is 50
strings.serverParam.modsRequiredByDefault.label: Mods Required by Default
strings.serverParam.modsRequiredByDefault.toolti: Overrides default value for 'required' for all mods.
strings.serverParam.name.label: Server Name
strings.serverParam.name.tooltip: Server name (what the Server will be seen as in the Server Browser)
strings.serverParam.networkViewDistance.label: Network View Distance
strings.serverParam.networkViewDistance.tooltip: Maximum network streaming range of replicated entities.
strings.serverParam.password.label: Server Password
strings.serverParam.password.tooltip: Password required to join the server.
strings.serverParam.passwordAdmin.label: Admin Password
strings.serverParam.persistenceEnabled.label: Persistence System
strings.serverParam.playerSaveTime.label: Player Save Time (secs)
strings.serverParam.playerSaveTime.tooltip: Default period in seconds for saving players for both Online and Local storage (player save can still be requested on demand).
strings.serverParam.port.label: A2S Port
strings.serverParam.publicAddress.label: Public Address
strings.serverParam.publicAddress.tooltip:
IP address registered in backend. This should be set to the public IP address to which clients can connect in order to reach the server (either IP of the server itself or IP of the machine that will forward data to the server).
If the entry is missing, empty or 0.0.0.0, then the public IP address will be automatically detected and used by the backend.
strings.serverParam.publicPort.label: Public Port
strings.serverParam.publicPort.tooltip:
UDP port registered in backend. If the server itself has a public IP address, this should be the same value as in bindPort.
Otherwise, this is the UDP port that is forwarded to the server.
strings.serverParam.rconAddress.label: Rcon Address
strings.serverParam.rconAddress.tooltip:
IP address to which the RCON socket will be bound.
It can be used to restrict connection to a particular network interface.
strings.serverParam.rconBlacklist.label: Rcon Blacklist
strings.serverParam.rconBlacklist.tooltip: A list of commands excluded from execution. Should not be used in conjunction with RCON Whitelist.
strings.serverParam.rconEnabled.label: Enable Rcon
strings.serverParam.rconMaxClients.label: Rcon Max Clients
strings.serverParam.rconMaxClients.tooltip: The maximum number of clients that can connect to RCON at the same time.
strings.serverParam.rconPassword.label: Rcon Password
strings.serverParam.rconPassword.tooltip:
RCON password for RCON clients to login with.
It is required for RCON to start, does not support spaces and must be at least 3 characters long.
strings.serverParam.rconPermission.label: Rcon Permission
strings.serverParam.rconPermission.tooltip:
Permission for all RCON clients:
	admin - The admin can perform any command.
	monitor - The monitor can only perform commands which do not change the server's state.
strings.serverParam.rconPort.label: Rcon Port
strings.serverParam.rconPort.tooltip: RCON protocol port on which the game listens.
strings.serverParam.rconWhitelist.label: Rcon Whitelist
strings.serverParam.rconWhitelist.tooltip: Specifies the list of commands that can be executed, and no other command is allowed. Should not be used in conjunction with RCON Blacklist.
strings.serverParam.saveRetention.label: Save Retention
strings.serverParam.saveRetention.tooltip:
Number of save points to keep for the current mission.
Requires Persistence System enabled.
strings.serverParam.serverMaxViewDistance.label: Server Max View Distance
strings.serverParam.serverMinGrassDistance.label: Server Min Grass Distance
strings.serverParam.slotReservationTimeout.label: Slot Reservation Timeout (secs)
strings.serverParam.slotReservationTimeout.toolt:
Sets the duration (in seconds) for how long will the backend and server reserve a slot for kicked player.
It is considered disabled when set to the minimal value, the value being the same as for a normal disconnect.
strings.serverParam.storages.label: Storages
strings.serverParam.storages.tooltip:
Case-insensitive named objects representing an override of the system configuration-provided storages. Optional child properties:
	"database" - changes the storage to use a different database than the default configured. Must match the name given in the databases object or "main".
Requires Persistence System enabled.
strings.serverParam.visible.label: Server Visible
strings.serverParam.visible.tooltip: Set the visibility of the server in the Server Browser.
Option to allow players to transmit on other factions radios. true is allow to communicate, false is listen-only
strings.serverParam.vonDisableDirectSpeechUi.too: Force clients to not have VON (Voice Over Network) Direct Speech UI.
strings.serverParam.vonDisableUi.tooltip: Force clients to not have VON (Voice Over Network) UI.
